audit.why: EVEN / 5.5-10 matches the 54.01% win rate over 5562 games; lane is Ahri-favoured early, Akali-favoured with items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet chart say Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Skill/Skill/Akali. Two different answers rendered to the same reader.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row; the packet chart is the authority and content already matches it.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side -> Ahri, phases[6].side -> Akali, ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Charm was described as a 'stun'; Perfect Execution's execute threshold and Assassin's Mark's auto-attack reset tell were absent; cooldown block carried no real numbers.
audit.why: Charm (E, 12s flat) instantly stops movement abilities, so it kills Shuriken Flip's dash mid-flight. Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and makes her unselectable, not immune to zones. Perfect Execution's recast executes below a health threshold. Akali's opener is a P auto reset.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, spikes[1].text, dontsFull[2].d, whys[2].

audit.why: Shroud 20s rank 1, Shuriken Flip 16s rank 1, Charm 12s flat, Spirit Rush 140s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three do/don't detail strings were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad and did not match their own titles.
audit.why: Templated filler; the title promised R discipline, poke targeting and wave discipline and the body said none of it.

edits.before: Akali wins by landing Twilight Shroud, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Akali wins by shrouding out of Charm, then executing you under Perfect Execution's threshold before your last dash is back.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Check it before every step-up. - R Spirit Rush (last dash) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and unselectable inside — step up in that window, not into it. - Shuriken Flip is 16s early: once she flips, her only re-engage is R. - Keep the third Spirit Rush dash for her Perfect Execution recast.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry by pre-empting her: Charm as she flips in, then dash clear of Perfect Execution's recast while its second half ticks.

edits.before: Track Akali’s Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Shroud hides her, it does not stop zones. Her combo opens with an Assassin's Mark auto reset — that wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W if he eats the return, and walk — repeat until the charm window is lethal instead of optimistic.
edits.after: Perfect Execution recasts in two halves and executes below a threshold — hold the third dash for the second half, never open a fight with it.

edits.before: Akali spends Twilight Shroud early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Her Q costs 110 energy at rank 1 — poke the farm she must walk to and she runs dry first.

edits.before: Charming on cooldown for chip damage and then facing his real engage with nothing — the charm is the matchup, not the poke.
edits.after: Charm is 12s flat — without it a Shuriken Flip in and a Perfect Execution out kills you outright, so hold the wave back.

edits.before: Level 3 is yours: Charm punishes any Shroud dash-in for a full stun and follow-up combo
edits.after: Level 3 is yours: Charm stops her Shuriken Flip dash mid-air and walks her into a full combo

edits.before: Both ultimates come online together — her Perfect Execution reset threatens a two-phase all-in, but your Spirit Rush also resets on takedown, so trading ults is close to even.
edits.after: Both ults land at 6 — Perfect Execution's second cast executes below a health threshold, so watch the HP number and not the bar; Spirit Rush's dashes get you above it.

notes: Full-layer level chart was entirely 'Skill' while content and packet agreed on Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Skill/Skill/Akali — proposed the four early rows and the late row as one atomic group so the two layers stop disagreeing. Several full-layer fields address Akali as 'he/his' (tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.feeding wording, dosFull[2].t); I fixed the ones I rewrote but tradeGood/tradeBad still read male and are duplicated verbatim into breakdown.trading and report[3].t — a pronoun-only fix there would be near-zero-delta and I left it rather than force a rewrite I could not ground. breakdown.feeding, ahead, breakdown.wave and loading are enemy-specific enough to survive.
